title: Seasonal Extra-Person Supplements — Room Reservations Tariff
content:
**Tariff note.** When an extra-person charge is added to a Room Reservations reservation for adults beyond those the plan's rate covers, the amount each charged adult pays per night depends on the award season of the arrival night and the length of the stay. When the arrival night is in the peak season and the stay is at least 5 nights, each charged adult pays the plan's extra-adult charge plus the peak long-stay supplement of 15.00; when the arrival night is in the peak season and the stay is shorter than 5 nights, or the arrival night is in the standard season and the stay is at least 5 nights, each charged adult pays the plan's extra-adult charge plus the mid-season supplement of 7.00; any other stay pays the plan's extra-adult charge alone.

The award season is the one recorded on the reservation for the arrival night (peak, standard or off-peak); the stay is the nights from the arrival date to the departure date.

## Per-adult charge per night

| Award season of the arrival night | Stay of 5 nights or more | Stay of 4 nights or fewer |
|---|---|---|
| Peak | plan's extra-adult charge plus 15.00 | plan's extra-adult charge plus 7.00 |
| Standard | plan's extra-adult charge plus 7.00 | plan's extra-adult charge alone |
| Off-peak | plan's extra-adult charge alone | plan's extra-adult charge alone |

## Figures by plan charge (hypothetical stays)

| Plan's extra-adult charge | Peak, 5 nights | Peak, 4 nights | Standard, 5 nights | Standard, 4 nights | Off-peak, 9 nights |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25.00 | 40.00 | 32.00 | 32.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| 35.00 | 50.00 | 42.00 | 42.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| 0.00 | 15.00 | 7.00 | 7.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

A stay of exactly 5 nights counts as at least 5 nights. On a plan whose extra-adult charge is 0.00, the supplement is the whole per-adult charge.
